text: James Hammond is a human child initially found at the Hammond Farmstead in Gilneas, where he became separated from his family during the Forsaken invasion of Gilneas. After the events of The Battle for Gilneas City, he appeared with his mother and sisters on board the night elven ship at Keel Harbor. Years later, after the reclamation of Gilneas, he reappeared as a grown young man who now resides in Stormglen Village with his family.
Jornah is an orc vendor located in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar.

Julia Henning is a human located at Wavestrider Beach north of the Caverns of Time in Tanaris during the Bronze Celebration. As seen in Spot the Difference, Y'lliya Xennin briefly takes on her form, revealing that he was the one who framed Scrapes for the murder of Herrkrop.

Kiya Featherpaw is a night elf in Moonkin Form found in the Eye of Ysera in the Emerald Dream. She is an umbraclaw keeper. She also takes care of the local somnowls, preparing care packages for them. When Galok Wingslicer invaded the Eye, Kiya had an idea to mobilize the umbraclaws. She directed them to attack the djaradin and fought the djaradin herself.

Knight Anais is a blood elf located at Sun's Reach Sanctum on the Isle of Quel'Danas during the assault by the Devouring Host. Together with Commander Koruth Mountainfist and Callum Ashvow, she is holding the bridge leading south-west.
Knight-Errant Bloodshatter is an orc death knight and a target of Prey hunts.
Korston Willard is a human located on the Rugged Dragonscale that sails between Stormwind City and the Waking Shores.

Krilge was an orc soldier who was stationed in Ashenvale to protect civilians from danger. He was the mate of Magar, a tailor in Orgrimmar. The two often met at Fallen Sky Lake before it was overrun by bog beasts, and Magar gave him a mooncloth scarf. Krilge later disappeared and was written off as a deserter, but Magar did not believe this and sent warlock adventurers to look for signs of him. The warlocks found Krilge's scarf on the body of a bog beast at Fallen Sky Lake, suggesting that he had died there. The warlocks used the scarf, a representation of Krilge and Magar's love, to summon and subdue an incubus minion, after which Gan'rul Bloodeye returned the item to Magar.
Krivit is a nerubian sage vendor located in the Skeins in the City of Threads.
Kylor Sunbourne is a blood elf located in Dawnstar Spire in Eversong Woods.

Captain Landen was a human warrior who served as the captain of the Lordaeron City Guard. Having led the guard with distinction and honor, Landen was one of the many victims of the fall of the Kingdom of Lordaeron, having instilled a great deal of faith in his protege, Garek Bandarion.
Light's Guidance is a Templar paladin hero talent. When active it grants the Hammer of Light ability.

Lil' Maggz is a pit lord companion available from 3 October 2023 to 31 October 2023 from the Battle.net Shop or In-Game Store. The companion will appear in the Trading Post no sooner than three months after 31 October 2023. He's named after the not-so-lil' Magtheridon. Obtaining this pet rewards the Lil' Maggz (achievement) feat of strength.

Lyldora was a member of the black dragonflight who defected to the Primalist cause and leaked the Shadowscales' plans to assassinate Mithruz, and for this was imprisoned in the dungeons of the Obsidian Citadel.
Lydia Tidepeak is a Kul Tiran human located in the Dwarven District in Stormwind City.
Lyssabel Dawnpetal is a night elf located in the Wizard's Sanctum in Stormwind City and at the Town Center on Founder's Point.
Lythielle Moonlight is a blood elf located in Fairbreeze Village in Eversong Woods.
Maethra Slagheart is a dwarf located in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.

Mairinn Boulderbreaker is a dwarf located in Olivia's Pond in Stormwind City during the Love is in the Air event. She is surrounded by several pets - Cats, Dogs, Playful Fawn, and Pettable Critters and directs adventurers to relax during the quest The Gift of Relaxation (Alliance).
Manifest Clerk Philmor is a human located at Stormwind Harbor in Stormwind City.

Marina Hollyden is a human located in Olivia's Pond in Stormwind City during the Love is in the Air event. She can be seen on a boat fishing in the pond and helps adventurers relax during the quest The Gift of Relaxation (Alliance).

Marran Trollbane is a human and the former regent of Stromgarde. A member of the House of Trollbane, she is the niece of King Danath, who appointed her as regent of the capital as his duties drew him to Stormwind City. However, unbeknownst to him, Marran was an idealist wishing to continue King Thoradin's legacy and follow in the footsteps of the Empire of Arathor, and who sought to make war upon the Mag'har Clans of Hammerfall to take control of the Arathi Highlands. Following the Battle of Go'Shek Farm, she was stripped of her position and arrested for treason by Danath. Despite her imprisonment, Marran and her followers created the Red Dawn, a human supremacist organization seeking to res
Maseara Autumnmoon is a night elf druid located in during Nightmare Incursions. In , she is a quest giver located at Forest Song.
Mass Eruption is a Scalecommander hero talent for Augmentation Evokers. Devastation Evokers get Mass Disintegrate instead.
Mass Disintegrate is a Scalecommander hero talent for Devastation Evokers. Augmentation Evokers get Mass Eruption instead.

Materialist Ophinell was a void elf located at the elven basecamp in the Twilight Highlands during the Twilight Ascension event. She sold cosmetic rewards in exchange for . She was marked on the minimap with the quartermaster icon. From 3 March to 17 March 2026 (between the end of the event and the start of Midnight Season 1), Materialist Ophinell could also be found next to the Twilight Highlands portal in Stormwind City and Orgrimmar, where she sold her items for Resonance Crystals. Standing across from her was Armorer Kalinovan, who sold equipment from the event.
Meluume is a nerubian sage located in the Umbral Bazaar in the City of Threads.
Mirioszin is an infinite dragon vendor located in the Parting Glass in Valdrakken. She trades Antique Bronze Bullion for the Jigglesworth, Sr. mount and Dragonflight Season 4 weapon cosmetics.
Moondust is an Elune's Chosen hero talent for druids. It is an exclusive choice node with Elune's Grace.
Morning Breeze is a Mistweaver monk talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Jade Empowerment.

Nalikrona is a slate-grey proto-dragon who moved into Vyranoth's territory in the Frozen Fangs. Prior to the onset of the War of the Scaleborn, Nalikrona and her mate Razviik had two clutches of eggs stolen from their nests by the stone-skins, and alongside their companion Szarnin were displaced from their hunting grounds by the dragonflights. In exchange for tribute, Vyranoth allowed the trio to take up residence in her territory; over the years, the mated pair of Nalikrona and Razviik would become as close as family to Vyranoth and their whelps would come to see Vyranoth as their grand dame. During the War of the Scaleborn, Neltharion proposed taking Nalikrona's whelps hostage to force Vyr
Nimble Flyer is a Scalecommander hero talent for evokers. It is an exclusive choice node with Slipstream (evoker hero talent).

Niliuq is the tuskarr spirit of the ocean, and specifically is one of the Great Spirits. According to Elder Nava's Tale of the Gleamfisher, Kauriq the Gleamfisher boasts of being faster than even her, and in response Niliuq capsizes Kauriq's boat. It is not specified what form Niliuq takes, but it is said that "she arose" and capsized the boat "with one great crash of wave," possibly implying that Niliuq does not take the form of an animal like several other tuskarr deities.

Nirobin is a member of the Azerothian Archives and a codicological archeologist. He is a self-proclaimed genius in the field of arcane codicology which is done through fusing blue and bronze dragon magic. This allows him to create an embodiment of all the information collectively gathered on a relic or a place, manifested in the form of an animal, which he can then transcribe into his journal. He is agoraphobic which leads to him never leaving his office. Instead, he uses arcane projections to interact with the outside world. He instructs adventurers on arcane codicology, naming them his assistants, and delegates to them the task of researching several locations around the Dragon Isles, incl

Olbarig is a member of the Stormriders, currently serving as one of Stormward Lufsela's Stormguards. He originally held this position under Stormward Baelgrim but left the order after a disagreement with Baelgrim regarding the binding of the stormrooks. Following this fallout, he became a hermit, dedicating his time to studying the cloudrooks in the Three Shields. He would later end up helping Lufsela revitalize the Stormriders and reclaiming his old role. He now serves in the city of Orgrimmar as the emissary on behalf of the Dornogal defense forces to the Horde.
Old Wilmar is a human found sitting on the bridge to Stratholme in the Eastern Plaguelands. Players who attempt to fly over Stratholme will fade to black and then wake up next to Wilmar.
Orator Krix'vizk is a nerubian sage and the first boss of the City of Threads, fought in the Umbral Bazaar.
Overpowered Barrier is a mage PvP talent, available at Level 20.

Queen Neferess is the former queen of the kingdom of Azj-Kahet. Dearly beloved by her subjects, she guarded the nerubians' independence from their former Old God masters until she was betrayed and usurped by her daughter, Ansurek, after the latter allied with Xal'atath. Neferess is publicly believed to be dead, but was in truth kept alive deep in the City of Threads and transformed into the First Ascended.

Queen Yz is a nerubian queen depicted by a statue in the Skeins in the City of Threads, on the southeastern side of the Royal Preservatorium. The statue's plaque can only be understood while under the effects of Potion of Polymorphic Translation: Nerubian.

Queen Xy'lasa is a nerubian queen depicted by a statue in the Skeins in the City of Threads, on the southern side of the Royal Preservatorium. The statue's plaque can only be understood while under the effects of Potion of Polymorphic Translation: Nerubian.

Ralph Frostfoe is a dwarf located in a Mysterious Cave in Zaralek Cavern. According to Mr. Sunflower, he was once an adventurer "purely focused on murder", before being captured in Mr. Sunflower's "rehabilitation" group. He was there longer than any other guest, and recently began speaking and fighting less. Because of that, Mr. Sunflower deemed him ready to reenter society and set him free. He left to be a minimalist in Westfall, leaving his old belongings behind. However, he later suffered a brief "relapse", though Mr. Sunflower is still proud of his improvements. At some point prior to his imprisonment, he acquired a mount near Ironforge, who was named Gertrude and wasn't a horse. He pref

Razviik is a mossy-green proto-dragon who served as one of Vyranoth's most trusted advisors and confidants during the War of the Scaleborn. Prior to the onset of the War of the Scaleborn, Razviik and his mate Nalikrona had two clutches of eggs stolen from their nests by the stone-skins, and alongside their companion Szarnin were displaced from their hunting grounds by the dragonflights. In exchange for tribute, Vyranoth allowed the trio to take up residence in her territory; over the years, the mated pair of Razviik and Nalikrona would become as close as family to Vyranoth and their whelps would come to see Vyranoth as their grand dame. Razviik stood guard over Vyranoth as she became a Prima
Relentless Primal Ferocity is a Survival hunter talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Symbiotic Adrenaline.

Rendris Salonar was a young high elf noble and a member of the House of Salonar. Years before the Great Wars, Rendris and his brother Aravan attended a party at Saltheril's Haven. They were joking about Lirath Windrunner and his lean build, inability to fight, and how he would use the flute in a duel. Sylvanas Windrunner overhead the jokes and intended to give them drinks with woundwood, but Lord Saltheril and Elisara Sunstriker drank them instead. During the burning of Quel'Thalas, Windrunner Village came under attack from the Old Horde and their Amani troll allies. They slaughtered most of the elves there, including Rendris. After the Horde retreated, Sylvanas arrived and discovered the de
Rinnoa is a void elf fishing trainer located in the Howling Ridge in the Voidstorm. She is studying an Oceanic Vortex.

Roska Rocktooth is a member of the Azerothian Archives and a geo-archeologist. She uses her elemental powers to help excavate artifacts and instructed adventurers on excavation. She leads adventurers on excavations on various locations around the Dragon Isles. She also takes part in The Big Dig: Traitor's Rest.
Roy Lewells is a human located at the Park in Stormwind City.

Ryzindormu was a member of the bronze dragonflight who defected to the Primalist cause. Ryzindormu's betrayal was responsible for the fall of the Veiled Ossuary to the Primalist forces, and the bronze dragon was imprisoned in the dungeons of the Obsidian Citadel for this crime.
Sebastian Jurgens is a mad scientist found on an oil rig between the South Seas islands off the coast of in the Great Sea.
Shadowmoon Mage is a monster ally card depicting an ogre mage from the Betrayal of the Guardian set.
Shattered Psyche is a Shadow priest talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Mental Decay.
Shatterfang is a proto-dragon that spawns to attack Clan Aylaag's caravan when the Aylaag Camp moves to a new location on the Ohn'ahran Plains.
Silkswooner Waree is a nerubian sage located in the City of Threads.

Sonnebrid is an earthen character in "The Thraegar's Descent", a play performed by the theater troupe at the Proscenium on the Isle of Dorn. She was a thraegar, a revered hero in earthen society. Compelled by a powerful call from deep within the earth (which she also calls a "song"), Sonnebrid embarks on a journey to the Heart of Azeroth. Throughout the journey, Sonnebrid faces numerous perils alongside fellow earthen adventurers. In the Ringing Deeps, they fend off angry kobolds. As they delve deeper into Hallowfall, the encroaching darkness tests their resolve. The final challenge arises when they confront the nerubians of Azj-Kahet. Despite a valiant stand, she and her companions are ulti

Speaker Kuldas is a member of the Machine Speakers. He is an Awakener--it's his duty to go into old places in the Ringing Deeps, or newly awakened ones, and make sure that everything is in working order. Therefore, he often times asks adventurers to accompany and defend him while he carries on with his duties. He also helped adventurers empower an Arathi tinderbox so it could better be of use to them. Around the time a certain earthen adventurer awoke from their slumber in the Awakening Machine, Speaker Kuldras had been working to restore the Bulwark of Authorization to its original state when a golem manifested out of nowhere and started attacking him and his machinists. Kuldras then asked

Stormrider Meirand is a member of the Stormriders. She took part in the defense of Dornogal against the nerubian forces who were seeking to destroy the Coreway. After the attack she flew off with Baelgrim to find the Councilward and could later be seen talking with Breem who expressed relief that Meirand was safe. Some time after she lost her stormrook in a battle and could be found recovering in Dornogal after being wounded from the fall.
Supportive Imbuements is a Totemic shaman hero talent. It grants the Tidecaller's Guard ability for Restoration. It is an exclusive choice node with Pulse Capacitor.

Szarnin is an ocher-colored proto-dragon who moved into Vyranoth's territory in the Frigid Fangs. Szarnin, alongside his companions Nalikrona and Razviik, were displaced from their hunting grounds by the dragonflights prior to the onset of the War of the Scaleborn. In exchange for tribute, Vyranoth allowed the trio to take up residence in her territory, and Szarnin told the ancient proto-dragon about how Nalikrona and Razviik's previous clutches had been stolen away from them by stone-skins.
Syrnoya is a night elf located at the moonwell in Auberdine in .
Symbiotic Adrenaline is a Survival hunter talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Relentless Primal Ferocity.
Tahlien was a member of the black dragonflight's Ironscales sent to the defense of the Emerald Gardens.

Talinstrasz was a member of the red dragonflight who became fiercely loyal to Vyranoth and joined the Primalist cause. As a whelp, Talinstrasz spent hours playing with Vyranoth in the Ruby Life Pools, alongside his sister Lailastrasza and their friends Atyrannus and Rygos. The siblings refused to hide during hide-and-seek games, afraid that the eyes in the rocks would steal them away from home again if they were left alone. Talinstrasz was among the drakes who incited conflict with the primal dragons in response to taunts regarding their ordered nature, but had begun to believe the primal dragons might have the right idea. He demanded answers about why his egg was ordered and why he was deni

Talvas is a high elf head groom, serving the Windrunners at Windrunner Spire before the Second War. He took care of their quel'dorei steeds. When Lireesa and Verath Windrunner were killed, Parley survived and quickly galloped home. Talvas immediately tended to it using woundwood, with Nathanos Marris following Talvas and briefly speaking with him. His fate afterward is unknown.

Terro is a deceased proto-dragon located at the Scorching Chasm in the Emerald Dream. Although he commanded the Primalist forces at the Scorching Chasm under Fyrakk's orders, he disagreed with attacking the Emerald Dream. Lethka saw him as an obstacle in her pursuit of power and killed him.
Tethris Dewgazer is a blood elf located in the Pathfinder's Den in Orgrimmar. After being asked to aid with Sylnaria Fareflame's duck problem, he teleports to Razor Hill in Durotar.
Tharessa Sunstrand is a blood elf member of the Algari Expedition. After the city's crash, she appears on the Isle of Dorn training as part of the expedition under Rannan Korren.
Thatog is an orc located upstairs of Soran's Leather and Steel Armory in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar.

Emperor Thoradin IX is the current ruler of the Arathi Empire. Like all Arathi emperors, he receives and interprets prophetic visions from the Sacred Flame and commands his subjects to either fulfill or forestall their prophesied events in order to allow the Empire to flourish. More than a decade before the events of , he received a vision of Light, battle, and victory for the Arathi. He saw a holy land, Hallowfall, and a source of radiant light, the "Emperor's Vision", in the form of a falling or fallen star. He assembled the bravest and strongest of the Empire into an expedition to seek out Hallowfall, fight in Renilash (the final battle between light and dark), secure the Emperor's Vision
Tiana Nevermorn is a blood elf located at the Silver Landing on the Isle of Quel'Danas. She oversaw the empowering of a dragonhawks being done by Priestess Islara, Priest Grimmin, and Caedmos.
Tizkren is a nerubian sage located in Toy Hollow in the City of Threads.
Toriesia Shimmesword is a night elf found speaking with Hanaeria Mooncaller in the Eye of Ysera in the Emerald Dream.
Torin'zel is a nerubian sage located in the City of Threads.
Tulumun is a nerubian sage found in the Weaver's Lair in Azj-Kahet. He also appears throughout the City of Threads. He ordered the deaths of Ki'katal the Harvester and Izo, the Grand Splicer.
Tursk was an orc who was found in Durotar during the original beta. He taught the following hunter pet abilities: *Clenched Pinchers *Tight Pinch *Tough Shell
Twillien Solistar is a void elf rogue located on Telogrus Rift. Next to him is Ella. When the Shadowguard attacked the Rift, he helped defend the area.
Ukos'via is a nerubian sage located in the Skeins in the City of Threads.

Unfortunate Zek is a dead member of Keg Leg's Crew located in Brew Bay in the Arathi Highlands during Plunderstorm. They lie dead in front of a Magical Chest, presumably killed by the nearby Angriest Chicken.

Vakan is one of the Zaqali Elders, he is a master of shadowflame and is locked in constant conflict with his fellow elder, Gholna, over who is stronger. Through devastation and chaos, each elder attempts to outdo the other until one of them is crowned victor.
Vael'thas Dawnsoar is a blood elf flight master located in Fairbreeze Village in Eversong Woods.
Vampiric Strike is a San'layn hero talent for death knights. When active, it grants use of the Vampiric Strike ability.

Viktoria Woods is a human located at Old Town in Stormwind City. She will trade Monster Hunter's First Rune Fragment, Monster Hunter's Second Rune Fragment, and Monster Hunter's Third Rune Fragment to warriors in exchange for Severed Kobold Head, Severed Murloc Head, and Severed Gnoll Head, respectively.
Visceral Strength is a San'layn hero talent for death knights.
Virulent Plague is a disease caused primarily by the death knight abilities Outbreak and Scourge Strike.
Void Blast is a Voidweaver hero talent for priests. It grants the Void Blast ability.
Void Empowerment is a Voidweaver hero talent for priests. It is an exclusive choice node with Darkening Horizon.
Vyean Lightstar is a blood elf located in Fairbreeze Village in Eversong Woods.
Wailing Dead is a Dark Ranger hunter hero talent. When active, it grants the Wailing Arrow ability.
Whaldak Darbenk was a dwarf who was found in Loch Modan during the original beta. He taught the following hunter pet abilities: *Poisonous Spit *Spider Poison *Web
Whirling Blade is a Protection warrior talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Ravager (warrior ability).
Wildstalker's Power is a Wildstalker hero talent for druids.
Xeph'itik is a nerubian sage located in the City of Threads.

Y'lliya Xennin is the satyr antagonist of the first chapter of the Guest Relations storyline. Players end up confronting him during Spot the Difference northeast of the Gaping Chasm in southeastern Tanaris. He is seen briefly taking on the form of Julia Henning, revealing that he was the one who framed Scrapes for the murder of Herrkrop, that he himself had committed.

Xalus Nihilus is a demon found in an instanced version of . It is the warlock's Inner Demon from Metamorphosis (warlock rune), drawn out by Fleuric. Defeating it will award Zila Amanemodas, allowing the warlock to remain in their humanoid form during Metamorphosis. Naturally, the Metamorphosis ability is unavailable during this battle.
Zaeka Steelbender is an orc located in the Gladiator's Refuge in Valdrakken. She sells Dragonflight Season 2's "Obsidian Combatant" recipes for Mark of Honor.

Zarstrasza is a red dragon in night elf visage located in Stormwind City who offers exchanges for the Obsidian Fragment, the Protocol Twilight currency as part of the Elemental Rune Dungeon. See Sylstrasza for the Horde-equivalent.
Zorastia was a member of the black dragonflight's Ironscales sent to the defense of the Emerald Gardens.
UFO Flight Computer is an alien artifact in XCOM: Enemy Unknown.

Aizel is a character in . He is a High Entia, and is one of the four knights that protected Melia in Alcamoth all her life. They accompanied her to Makna Forest to kill the Leone Telethia, but were destroyed by the Telethia, while Melia was knocked unconscious and left for dead, until she is found and rescued by the party.

Arglas (English dub: ) is a supporting character in . He is a member of a race of beings known as Giants, and was possibly their leader. He is never met during the events of the game, although his body is possessed by Zanza on Prison Island. As himself, Arglas is seen only in flashbacks.

Azurda (Japanese: , Seiryū) is a character in . Azurda is a small Titan, and takes the appearance of a flying white dragon. Rex lives on his back and calls him Gramps (Japanese: , Jitchan, Grandpa). Azurda serves as Rex's guardian, as well as his home. They travel together through the Cloud Sea. After sustaining near-fatal injuries from an encounter with Jin and Malos, Azurda manages to survive, but in the process is reverted to a larval state, a tiny white dragon with a core crystal in his chest. In this form, Azurda travels as Rex's companion, usually traveling inside his helmet. During the battle, he is reliable and, though sometimes loud, will give Rex various pieces of advice; specifica

Damil is a character in . He is a High Entia, and is one of the four knights that protected Melia in Alcamoth all her life. They accompanied her to Makna Forest to kill the Leone Telethia, but were destroyed by the Telethia, while Melia was knocked unconscious and left for dead, until she is found and rescued by the party.

Dagahn (Japanese: , Dagan, Dagun; English dub: ) is an antagonist in . He is first seen standing on the walls of New Los Angeles as the city is being invaded by forces of the Ganglion with his companion Ryyz. __TOC__

Garan is a character in . He is a High Entia, and is one of the four knights that protected Melia in Alcamoth all her life. They accompanied her to Makna Forest to kill the Leone Telethia, but were destroyed by the Telethia, while Melia was knocked unconscious and left for dead, until she is found and rescued by the party.

Hogard is a character in . He is a High Entia, and is one of the four knights that protected Melia in Alcamoth all her life. They accompanied her to Makna Forest to kill the Leone Telethia, but were destroyed by the Telethia, while Melia was knocked unconscious and left for dead, until she is found and rescued by the party.

Lorithia (Japanese: , Rouran, Laulan; English dub: ) is an antagonist in . She is the leader of the High Entia's Ministry of Research; as such, she mostly operates by designing new technologies and weapons for her people. She has something of a rivalry with Dickson, but nonetheless tolerates him for his knowledge and abilities.

Mòrag Ladair (Japanese: , Merefu Rahatto, Meleph) is a main playable character in . She is the Special Inquisitor of the Empire of Mor Ardain. She is a Driver and is accompanied by her Blade, Brighid. She is called "the Flamebringer" (Japanese: , Honō no ki kōshi, Radiant Young Noblewoman of Flame), and is known as the most powerful Driver in the Empire, serving Emperor Niall, her adopted younger brother and biological cousin. She is designed by Masatsugu Saito, the lead character designer of the game. She joins the party during the battle against Patroka and Mikhail in Chapter 4. Upon joining the party, Mòrag is equipped with common Spring Shoes.

Ryyz (Japanese: , Rīzu, Leeds; English dub: ) is an antagonist in . She is first seen standing on the walls of New Los Angeles with her companion Dagahn as the city is being invaded by forces of the Ganglion.

Professor Tatazo is a character in . He is Tora's father, and who worked with his own father Professor Soosoo to create an artificial Blade called Lila, due to the family's lack of ability to awaken Blades via Core Crystals. However, the laboratory was attacked, resulting in Soosoo's apparent death, the seizure of the unfinished Lila, and the abduction of Tatazo. However before his capture, Tatazo managed to hand over a finished ether furnace and artificial Blades blueprints to Tora, who quickly escaped capture. Tatazo is later found in the Old Factory in the Empire of Mor Ardain, being forced to manufacture artificial Blades for Bana. After being rescued, he and Lila relocate to Tora's Hous

Xord (Japanese: , Zōdo; English dub: ) is an antagonist in . As Mysterious Face (Japanese: , Nazo no Feisu), he is the second Faced Mechon that Shulk meets and is the first Mechon to talk in the game. Xord features the ability to transform into a bulky jet, similar to Metal Face.

Bunnie () is a fictitious character in the Xenosaga universe. It is sometimes regarded as the mascot of the Xenosaga series itself. Multiple instances of Bunnie act as NPCs, in particular on the Elsa.
Emperor Cain is a character in Xenogears and the emperor of Solaris. He, alongside the Gazel Ministry, were the first humans born on the planet where Xenogears takes place.
Camelle is a general term in the Xenosaga series referring to citizens of the Galaxy Federation who work in corporations or fields relating to the government.
Consul V is an antagonist in Xenoblade Chronicles 3. He is a member of the Consuls and appears during Side Story: Taion, as well as briefly in flashbacks in Side Story: Noah and A Deep-Seated Scar.

Deus () is an antagonist in Xenogears. It is fought twice, once in Mahanon, and again in its core. It is referred to as a god by many of the Xenogears world's inhabitants. But in reality, it is a biological weapon created by humans in ancient times on another planet. Although it is the penultimate boss, because the boss after Deus is extremely easy, Deus is considered by many to be the final boss of the game.
Eleanor (, Eleanor) is the main protagonist of Xenoblade Genesis. She is one of the Vesselai, a group of characters that can wield the power of . She is a student at the academy Leukos.
Ethelle is a general term in the Xenosaga series referring to citizens of the Galaxy Federation who do not work in a field relating to the government or corporations.
Lactis is a playable character in Xenosaga: Pied Piper. He is a member of the Galaxy Federation Police's 1875th Special Operations Command and a subordinate of Jan Sauer.

Luis Virgil () is a supporting character in the Xenosaga series. He is an A.G.W.S. pilot for the Galaxy Federation aboard the Woglinde. Virgil is also a guest party member in Xenosaga Episode I and Xenosaga I & II.
Pierre Ruryk () is a supporting character in Xenosaga I & II. He is one of the representative members of the Salvator Faction in the Galaxy Federation Parliament.

Sellers is an antagonist in the Xenosaga series. He is a scientist with connections to both the Galaxy Federation and the U-TIC Organization, and holds the position of technology consultant and Assistant Director in the Ormus Department of Sacraments. He later defects and sides with Dmitri Yuriev and the Salvator Faction for his own self-interest.

Lieutenant Commander Vanderkam () is a character in the Xenosaga series. He is a commanding officer at the U-TIC Organization who works undercover as a lieutenant commander in the Galaxy Federation's 117th Marine Division.
Drogan Ironshaper is a dwarf located in Fort Wildervar in Howling Fjord.

Drog Skullbreaker is an orc warrior who wanders around Dalaran and acts like a player (using Hearthstone, training professions, checking the bank, etc.). In Ahj-Kahet: "I will watch and make sure those beasts don't stray too close to camp. If they do ... they will swiftly discover why I am called Skullbreaker."
Drill Sergeant Steamcrank is a gnome warrior trainer. He was first involved in Operation: Gnomeregan. He later appears at New Tinkertown in Dun Morogh, training new warriors.
Drumion is a blood elf food and drink vendor at Furien's Post in Desolace.
Drukan is a Dark Iron dwarf and the chief aid of Moira Thaurissan.
Dro Shadowfree is an orc leatherworking supplier at the Horde outpost of Silverwind Refuge recently taken in Ashenvale.

Drugan Deepdraught is a dwarf located at the Quel'Delar's Rest in Icecrown. Since the Cataclysm, Prospector Drugan is located at the Gol'Bolar Quarry in Dun Morogh. He is interested in priceless artifacts and sends Alliance adventurers to bring him 8 Frozen Artifacts. He stands where Prospector Gehn used to stand.
Drokil is an orc stable master located at the Barn in Frostwall.
Drivnul is an orc located at the Zeth'Gol‎ in Tanaan Jungle.
Drogrin Alewhisker is a dwarf located at Thovas Base-Camp in Tiragarde Sound.
Drill Sergeant Smithson is a human located in the Proudmoore Barracks in Boralus.
Drok Scrollstabber is an orc located at Rhonin's Shield in the Azure Span.
Drunk Grunt is an orc who challenged Ariok to a fight during the first Azerothian Kosh'harg in Razor Hill in Durotar.

Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff is a human located just south of the entrance to Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands. He was one of the Dawn's most respected leaders and is a brilliant linguist. Zverenhoff appears at the Battle for Light's Hope Chapel during The Light of Dawn (quest).
Duke Hydraxis is a water elemental located in The Heart of Azeroth, where he is a shaman champion. He is the leader of the Hydraxian Waterlords, and is a servant of Neptulon the Tidehunter.

Duke Falrevere is the pirate lord of the Bloodsail Buccaneers. He holds court in Bloodsail Hold on Plunder Isle. Jessi and Magrann Falrevere are his children and are also members of the Bloodsail. Falrevere's wife was left behind in Kul Tiras and none know her fate. Falrevere spends almost all his time aboard the Devil Shark, hunting Blackwater Raiders, and stops off in Bloodsail Hold only occasionally. He is distant, with few friends. Lester Zank and Jessi are the only people the duke allows into his conﬁdence. Falrevere is tall and lanky, with black hair, long mustache, and a short beard. He wears a tri-corner black hat pulled low over his eyes. He is neither affable nor likable but keeps

Duggan Wildhammer is a rare mob Wildhammer clan dwarf, who seems to have met a rather unfortunate fate. He discovered crates of barley and foolishly made mead with it, which turned out to be plagued. He is found in the Eastern Plaguelands. He is neutral (though able to be attacked) to Horde and Alliance players alike.

Duelist Larenis is a blood elf located at Falconwing Square in Eversong Woods. He used to be a weapon master, and taught the following weapon styles for (less faction bonus) subject to your class being able to learn them: * Daggers * One-handed swords * Two-handed swords * Bows * Polearms
Duke August Foehammer is a dwarven warrior and a member of the 7th Legion. He was one of the leaders of the Might of Kalimdor until it was disbanded.

Dughal Stormwing is a Wildhammer dwarf prisoner inside the Detention Block of Blackrock Depths. He is a member of the Wildhammers of Aerie Peak, and was presumably taken prisoner during a skirmish with the Dark Iron dwarves.

Duncan Pike is a human knight. While on a mission to deliver orders to a covey stationed at the borders of the Swamp of Sorrows, he was attacked by a large reptile. The beast managed to pin Duncan, but before it could strike a killing blow, an orc lept out of the trees and attacked the beast. Recovering, Duncan and the orc managed to defeat the beast. Duncan was unsure how to react to the wounded orc, but remembering his father's words about judging others by their actions and nothing else, he offered his hand to the orc. Despite not being able to speak each other's language, Duncan and the orc set out for a goblin outpost where they could get aid.
Duane is a human in the Dragonblight. He is tired of the snobolds who trashed his camp at the 7th Legion Front during a wyrm hunter.
Duke Vallenhal is a human death knight found at the Ruby Dragonshrine in the Dragonblight. He is accompanied by Worn Bloodworms. His unholy energy needs to be drained for In Service of the Unholy.

Dubin Clay is a dwarf located in the Magus Commerce Exchange of Dalaran. Accoring to Imindril Spearsong, he is stubborn. During the purge of Dalaran, he was sitting on a rim at the entrance of the shop. When Dalaran relocated above Deadwind Pass, he fought against invading demons. He doesn't appear on the Broken Isles.
Dular is a night elf druid trainer located at Lor'danel in Darkshore. He may be found outside the inn so the south west of the mailbox, next to a tree beside the bridge.
Duglas Mullan is the Wildhammer dwarf leader of a band of Wildhammer clan elite gryphon riders. He is located at The Boneyard in the Twilight Highlands.

Duke Reginald Baradin II was the founder and leader of Baradin's Wardens. After his death, he was succeeded by Commander Marcus Johnson. Mathias Shaw considers Reginald to have been a "good man". Nothing else is known about him.
Dumpy is a dwarf located at the basement of Lakeshire Inn. He is one of the fighters who apparently loses against Big Earl.
Duff McStrum is a dwarf located in A Little Patience scenario.
Duke Studlington is a blood elf found in the Brawl'gar Arena. Nairi the Strong doesn't like him and says his name is fake.
Duenna Leafspring is a night elf of the Druids of the Talon camp in Skysea Ridge in Gorgrond. She is standing around a map of along with two Skysea Druids.

Dul'zak is an orc found in Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. He was a one of the newer recruits that joined the Garrison. His job was to patrol the keep when the Heart of Gorgorek was retrieved. He was killed by the . He is the objective in Garrison Campaign: Missing Grunt.
Duane Holmes is a human located in Arom's Stand in Drustvar.
Druza Netherfang is an orc located at both Port of Zandalar in Dazar'alor and Ar'gorok in the Arathi Highlands. She offers portals between the two locations, to soldiers of the Horde.
Drusilla Whiteblade is a human located in Ashvane Foundry in Tiragarde Sound.
Duncan Ironeye is a Dark Iron dwarf located in the Waking Shores and Ohn'ahran Plains.

Duncon Ratsbon is a human of the Defias Brotherhood. When he originally joined the Defias, he wasn't a member of the Stonemasons Guild but became a thief, and according to Vanessa, he was the biggest brute of the Defias. When Count Clessington offered revenge on Stormwind, Duncon and a number of Defias members joined him. After being discovered by Vanessa VanCleef and a Stormwind champion in the Deadmines in Westfall, Duncon joined Clessington in the assault on Northshire Valley in Elwynn Forest. The Stormwind champion fought him off, but Duncon escaped, intending to continue leading the Defias.
Duligosa was a blue dragon who was killed by Neltharion's betrayal during the War of the Ancients. Her name is on a Faded Gravestone at the Veiled Ossuary.
Duokna is an orc general goods vendor located in the Valley of Trials in Durotar. She will occasionally walk up on the nearby table and start dancing, prompting Galgar to tell her to stop.
Durnan Furcutter is a dwarf cloth and leather armor vendor located in Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh.
Durik is an orc stable master located in Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.
Durtham Greldon is a dwarf located in the Forlorn Cavern in Ironforge.
Dungeon Deserter is the debuff a player receives if they leave a dungeon group before it has killed one of the primary targets.
Durnt Brightfalcon is a Wildhammer dwarf located at the Menders' Stead in Western Plaguelands. He informs Alliance adventurers when the Battle for Andorhal resumes.

Duree was an old human widow and a secretary working for Jaina Proudmoore. She was known to wear spectacles and to frustrate her master by questioning her decisions. As a result, Jaina often pondered about turning Duree into a newt or throwing fireballs at her. When Jaina learned about the Orgath'ar ship's conflict, the mage returned to Theramore and sent Duree to get Chamberlain Kristoff and Colonel Lorena. As she is not seen in Tides of War or any other content, her status remains unknown.
Durango is a troll general goods vendor located at Bambala in Northern Stranglethorn. During the events of Rise of the Zandalari, he was poisoned but soon healed by Bwemba.

Durrin Direshovel is a Dark Iron dwarf located at Terror Run in Un'Goro Crater. He was sent by Emperor Thaurissan to find and set up an archaeology dig site. According to Spark Nilminer, he is a reckless archaeologist.

Dungar Frostmane is an orc of the Frostwolf clan found at Stonefang Outpost in Frostfire Ridge. After the Thunderlord clan's attack on the outpost, Dungar can be found trying to dislodge a fallen rylak from a tree. Roknor is Dungar's stable hand, and he gives information regarding his whereabouts.
Durkath Steelmaw is an orc located in Camp Thornscar in Spires of Arak.

Duroc Ironjaw is an orc located at the Legerdemain Lounge in Dalaran. He was adventuring in Val'sharah until he came across Crooked Tree. Sensing something sinister about it, he warns everyone he meets at the inn.

Durgan Stonestorm is a dwarf located in the Breach of the Tomb of Sargeras alongside Illidan Stormrage, Archmage Khadgar, Prophet Velen, and Maiev Shadowsong. He can be seen from the Cathedral of Eternal Night. A shaman totem is next to him. He gives the raid a 60% speed boost upon entry after defeating the first boss, Goroth.
Dupree is a human located in Brawl'gar Arena and Bizmo's Brawlpub.

Duroz Scaletaker is an orc located with Kolgar Flameguard at the Ruby Lifeshrine in the Waking Shores. He fought in the Second War as a member of Dragonmaw clan, where he broke even small dragon whelps. After the conflict, he was put in an internment camp, and then joined the New Horde. Years later he fought against Garrosh Hellscream, Zaela and Sylvanas Windrunner. He had a nasty fight against the Kor'kron, who took out both of his knees. In the waning years of his life, full of regrets, he traveled to the Dragon Isles to find something to smooth out the pain alongside Kolgar Flameguard.
Dustwind Turban is one of the best caster helms outside of the 40-man dungeons and is exceptional for healers.
Dvalen Ironrune is an iron dwarf located in Ulduar in the scenario Ulduar's Oath. He accompanies the Battlelord back to Skyhold.
Dwarf Hunter was a dwarf located in Frostfire Ridge. She was taken out by the followers sent from the Frostwall garrison.
Dustin Fowler is a human located at the Cupola Cafe in Boralus.
Earthen Vest is a tailor made chest piece providing spirit and stamina.
Earthen Ring Flamecaller is an Earthen Ring member located in the Slave Pens during Midsummer Fire Festival.
Early Frost is a Frost mage talent that reduces the cast time of Frostbolt by milliseconds, if you are in the middle of casting Frostbolt and stop, the internal cooldown will still pop.

Earthcaller Torunscar is a jungle troll member of the Earthen Ring. Torunscar first appeared during the Elemental Unrest in Orgrimmar. He is a quest giver found in both Deepholm and at the Ring of the Elements in the Twilight Highlands. He helps lead the Earthen Ring forces against the forces of Therazane until enough good will had been build up between the two sides that they could talk. At which point Tornscar becomes the advocate for the Earthen Ring in Therazane court hoping to gain enough support that she might give over the third piece of the World Pillar. After Therzane hands over the fragment of the world pillar, he helps with the ritual and the defense of the Temple of Earth as they
Earth-Master Rogok is an orc found north of the Dark Portal in the Blasted Lands.
Dysong was a blood elf mage in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar next to the portal to Hellfire Peninsula.
Earth is a Pandaren spirit warrior created by the Brewmaster.
Dying Skulltaker is an orc found at the Crimson Fen in Gorgrond.
Eagletalon Battlegear is the tier 19 hunter set. The look of the set was inspired by Sylvanas Windrunner and her dark rangers.
Eagle's Bite is a Survival hunter artifact trait. It is linked to the Fluffy, Go and Lacerating Talons traits.
Dying Grom'kar Grunt is an orc located in Cragplume Cauldron in Gorgrond. He and his unit were ambushed by Mandrakor, who has now taken up residence in the cave he was fleeing, as he was struck down.
Dylan is a human located in Mariner's Row in Boralus. He can be found running around with Victoria.
Lord Dylan McCreary is a deceased human buried at Barrowknoll Cemetery in Drustvar.
Eager Alchemist is a human ghost located at the Lost Estate in Stormsong Valley.
Dynamite Jack is a human located in Castaway Point in Tiragarde Sound.
Earthen Ring Smith is an orc located in Deliverance Point on the Broken Shore.
Ebonlocke is a ghostly noble, member of the Nobles of Darkshire, located at the Banquet Hall in Karazhan. He is annoyed by the party, organized by Moroes.
Earthwatcher Komo is a member of the Earthen Ring that is found in Silver Tide Hollow, Shimmering Expanse.

Earthwatcher Faldor is a member of the Earthen Ring found in Silver Tide Hollow of the Shimmering Expanse. He seems to be in a state of surprise that the Wildhammer dwarves are beneath the sea as members of the Earthen Ring.

Earthwarden Yrsa is a Wildhammer dwarf shaman affiliated with the Earthen Ring. She is located inside the Stonecore instance where she had been stationed to make sure the Twilight's Hammer cultists would not retake the Temple of Earth.
Ebba Stormfist is a dwarf located at Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Ebonizer Scrounge is a Forsaken character in Smokywood Pastures Presents: A Winter Veil Carol.
Ebon Fever is an Unholy death knight talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Bursting Sores.
Eastpoint Fishing Apprentice is a human child located in Tiragarde Sound.
Edris Barleybeard is a dwarf drink vendor located in the Military Ward in Ironforge. She works at Bruuk's Corner.
Edwin Harly is a Forsaken general goods vendor located in the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.
Edwina Monzor is a human bow vendor located in Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.

Edirah is a draenei mage trainer located at the Hall of the Mystics in the Vault of Lights in the Exodar. She directs mages to Maginor Dumas for questing. Periodically, a Worker will walk up to Edirah, who will give him some Conjured Bread that he in turn takes to Nus. During the Burning Legion's third invasion of Azeroth, Edirah joined the Tirisgarde and moved to the Hall of the Guardian acting as a researcher and the author of the Archive of the Tirisgarde. During the Battle for the Exodar, she was inside Velen's protective shield, lying.
Edward Orrick is a human found in Stone Crow Tavern in Old Stratholme, where he was the cook. He is also seen in the Deaths of Chromie scenario.
Eddy is a mini-boss water spirit found in the room with during Cleaning House (Valley of the Four Winds).
Ecilam is the Alliance mage leader in Stormshield Outpost, Ashran. He serves as the Mage Portal NPC for the Alliance in Ashran.
Edith Shareflagon is a dwarf located at Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Echo Slam was an Arms warrior honor talent, available at rank 28.
Ed Floren is an undead death knight located at Deliverance Point in the Broken Shore.
Edmund Hackney is a human located in Staghelm Point in Silithus: The Wound.
Edwin Maldus is a human located at Barbthorn Cave in Drustvar.
Edward Stephens is a human located at Stephen's Food Court in Boralus.
Eddie Norwington is a human child located in Tiragarde Sound at the estate owned by his parents, Lord Aldrius and Lady Elena.
Egert Tominson is a human located in the Roughneck Camp in Tiragarde Sound.
Eddie Haribull is a human located at the Deadwash in Stormsong Valley.
Effusive Mists is a Mistweaver monk artifact trait. It is linked to the Tendrils of Revival and Whispers of Shaohao traits.
Edward Nash is a human located in Tiragarde Sound. He is part of Taelia Fordragon's patrol squad.
Echonormu is a bronze dragon located at Algeth'ar Academy in Thaldraszus.
Echoing Reverberation is a Mistweaver monk talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Accumulating Mist.

Eitrigg is an aging orc warrior and prominent figure amongst his people. He is a veteran of the First and Second Wars. After an encounter with Tirion Fordring, the two warriors came to respect each other and later became friends despite the animosity between their two races. Eitrigg served the Horde as an advisor to the Warchief. His wise counsel was considered valuable by Thrall, but disregarded by Garrosh Hellscream. He also joined Tirion in Northrend as a commander of the Argent Crusade's Zul'Drak division. After the Fourth War, Eitrigg served to keep the orcs strong, and by the time of , he became the chieftain of the Blackrock clan.

Elaine Carevin is a human located in Darkshire in Duskwood. As a member of the Carevin family, she is intrigued by the strange happenings in Raven Hill and wonders what became of the old hermit, Abercrombie. During the third invasion of the Burning Legion, Elaine was seen cowering in fear in her house when the Veiled Hand controlled the town.

Eivi Nightfeather is a night elf druid part of the Hodir encounter in Ulduar. She, along with her excavation team are trapped inside icicle blocks and must be freed if the raid wants help against Hodir. In 10man version she is replaced by Ellie Nightfeather.
Egnom is a mage trainer at the Crossroads in the Northern Barrens. He is surrounded by Molten Armor. During the Legion Invasions, he defended the town.
Elanu was a female night elf killed by Ralaar and Arvell while they had lost their minds to the Pack Form.

Elder Tsulan is the leader of one of the pandaren refugee caravans in Kun-Lai Summit. He represents the pandaren that the players recruit into the Alliance after being displaced by the enraged yaungol tribes. His Horde counterpart is Elder Shiao.

Elder Shiao is the leader of one of the pandaren refugee caravans in Kun-Lai Summit. He represents the pandaren that the players recruit into the Horde after being displaced by the enraged yaungol tribes. His Alliance counterpart is Elder Tsulan.

Elariel is a night elf located on the eastern waterline of Teldrassil. Next to her, she has her trusty Scruffy Worg Pup along with bags of Assassins-Grade Blinding Powder and Assassins-Grade Flash Powder. She is surrounded by Sneaky Marmots.
Elder Surehide is an orc vendor found in Stonefang Outpost in Frostfire Ridge. She also appears as one of the traders in the Frostwall's Trading Post.

Elder Zhanak was an old orc shaman who had watched over the Stones of Prophecy for decades. He understood the elemental spirits were not peaceful but energetic and not passive but adaptive. He accepted their various moods, knowing there wasn't much he could do about it. He meditated, patiently waiting for the elements to speak to him when they wanted. He was nearly blind, seeing only smudges of light and shadow beyond two arms' length, but his waning senses were not so crippling with the elements as his ally. He was assisted by several apprentices. When arrived to the Stones of Prophecy to verify Garrosh's claims, Zhanak intended to turn the group away. While he showed warmth and respect tow

Elarisiel was a night elf who sought out Illidan Stormrage in Outland to fight the Burning Legion, becoming one of the first Illidari demon hunters he trained. She was wounded during the invasion of Nathreza, but was saved by Illidan and Vandel and ultimately joined the other demon hunters in traveling to Mardum.
Elder Xang is a pandaren monk of the Order of the Broken Temple located on the Wandering Isle.
Eldrin is a human tailor and artisan tailoring trainer located at the Eastvale Logging Camp in Elwynn Forest. He can be found inside a house on the west end of the camp.
Eldrim Mounder is a dwarf located in Fort Wildervar in Howling Fjord.

Elisa Steelhand is a dwarf blacksmithing vendor located at the Auberdine Refugee Camp in Darkshore. Before the Cataclysm, she could be found in the now-ruined Auberdine. She also appears during the Battle for Darkshore.
Elizabeth Jackson is a human who resides within Valgarde's inn in the Howling Fjord, up on a hill overlooking the area. She is on the second floor of the building.

Eligor Dawnbringer is a human paladin originally located at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands, and during the third invasion of the Burning Legion, in the Sanctum of Light. He is the Commander and representative leader of the Brotherhood of the Light, a subsection of the former Argent Dawn's ranks, now the Argent Crusade of which he is a Crusade Commander.

Ellen Stanbridge is a human member of the Argent Dawn and was taken prisoner by the Scarlet Crusade in the Scarlet Enclave. When the death knights of Acherus invaded the Enclave, the prisoners traded owners. Human death knights have a chance to execute Stanbridge, who was a friend from your past in Elwynn, before you were turned into a death knight. In the quest A Special Surprise, you are ordered to kill her. Before you do, she attempts to convince you to change your mind. However, she accepts death so that you would not be killed too as a result of your failure to follow orders.

Elizabeth Barker Winslow is a human Pilgrim's Bounty Vendor available during the Pilgrim's Bounty event. She is located outside the front gate of Ironforge and is dressed in traditional female pilgrim attire.
Elementium Deathplate Battlegear is the tier 12 frost/unholy death knight set.
Elementium Deathplate Battlearmor is the tier 12 blood death knight set.

Ellia Ravenmane is the primary "antagonist" of the Cradle of Chi-Ji storyline. An overeager trainee, Ellia is defeated by the adventurer repeatedly and slips further and further into desperation, before falling into despair. It is unknown what became of her. When an adventurer defeats her in her final fight, she jumps off the pedestal. She may have died or escaped.

Ellie was a Dark Iron dwarf located somewhere in . She was the wife of Hansel Heavyhands and had been kidnapped by the Iron Horde. Hansel originally traveled to Draenor to save her, but all references to her were scrapped before the release.
Elementalist Utrah is an orc found north of the Dark Portal in the Blasted Lands.
Eli Cannon is a human located at the Lunarfall in . He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Elisa Vanning is a human vendor located at the Lunarfall in .
Eliezer Hammerbeard is a Wildhammer dwarf located at Deliverance Point in the Broken Shore. He is a scholar.
